attributes.board_name: Vermont Board of Pharmacy (Office of Professional Regulation)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Courses approved by ACPE, AMA Category 1, the Board or a Board-designated entity
rules.notes: At least 6 hours each biennial period as a condition of renewal. Registration also requires Board-approved national certification or a Board-approved training program.
rules.legal_basis: Administrative Rules for the Vermont Board of Pharmacy, Rules 4-3 and 6-1 (eff. Feb 1, 2026)
rules.rule_quote: (c) Pharmacy Technicians, 6 hours. A pharmacy technician must complete at least 6 hours of approved continuing education coursework.
